script:
Take a deep breath.

Slowly breathe in through your nose, and gently breathe out.

Once again, breathe in… and breathe out.

For the next few moments, you don't need to do anything. You don't need to solve your problems, answer anyone's questions, or figure out what comes next. This moment belongs entirely to you.

Allow your body to relax. Release the tension in your shoulders. Unclench your jaw. Let your hands rest comfortably.

Feel yourself becoming a little more relaxed with every breath.

Now, gently bring your attention to the present moment.

Perhaps your mind is full of thoughts about the past. Things you wish you had done differently. Words you wish you could take back. Moments you wish you could experience again.

Or perhaps you're thinking about the future. The things you're worried about, the dreams you're chasing, and the uncertainty of what lies ahead.

Whatever is on your mind, you don't have to fight it.

Simply acknowledge your thoughts, and let them pass.

You are not your worries. You are not your mistakes. You are not the things that happened to you.

You are the person who is here, right now, breathing, growing, and learning.

And that is enough.

Take another slow, deep breath.

As you breathe in, imagine yourself breathing in peace, warmth, and calm.

As you breathe out, imagine releasing the stress, the pressure, and the expectations you've been carrying.

You don't have to carry everything at once.

You don't have to have your entire life figured out.

You are allowed to be a work in progress.

Sometimes, we become so focused on becoming the person we want to be that we forget to appreciate the person we already are. We forget how far we've come. We forget all the difficult days we've survived and all the little moments that helped us grow.

So, for a moment, give yourself permission to be proud of yourself.

Even if you're not where you want to be yet.

Even if things aren't happening as quickly as you hoped.

Even if nobody else sees how hard you're trying.

Your progress still matters.

Your efforts still matter.

And you matter, even when you're not achieving anything.

Let those words settle into your mind.

You do not have to earn your rest. You do not have to prove your worth. You do not have to be productive every moment of every day to deserve happiness.

You are worthy of kindness, including your own.

Now, imagine yourself standing somewhere peaceful. Perhaps you're beside a quiet ocean, watching the gentle waves move toward the shore. Perhaps you're in a beautiful forest, surrounded by tall trees and warm sunlight.

Feel the calmness of this place.

Listen to the sounds around you.

There is nowhere else you need to be. Nothing else you need to do.

Just breathe.

Let the world continue moving around you while you give yourself permission to slow down.

And remember, whatever you're going through right now is only one part of your story. You cannot predict every beautiful thing that might happen to you. You cannot know every person you'll meet, every opportunity you'll discover, or every version of yourself you'll become.

There is still so much life waiting for you.

You don't need to rush toward it.

You can take things one day at a time.

One breath at a time.

One small step at a time.

Take one final, deep breath.

And as you slowly exhale, remind yourself:

I release what I cannot control.

I forgive myself for being human.

I welcome peace into my life.

I trust myself to take the next step.

I am allowed to grow at my own pace.

And right here, in this moment, I am enough.

Stay here for a little longer.

Breathe gently.

Relax completely.

And when you're ready, carry this feeling of peace with you.

You deserve moments like this.

You deserve a life that feels good on the inside, not just one that looks good on the outside.

And you deserve to enjoy the journey, not just the destination.

Be gentle with yourself.

You are doing better than you think.
